description_en: Retrieves a filterable list of test cases from the test case repository
description_zh: 获取测试用例库中的测试用例列表，支持条件过滤
name: GetTestcaseList

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the test case library.
parameters.description_zh: 用例库id，用例库唯一标识
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the test case library
parameters.help_zh: 用例库id，用例库唯一标识
parameters.name: space_identifier

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the directory. Omit this parameter to return all test cases from the test case library.
parameters.description_zh: 目录id，目录唯一标识，如果不填写，则默认该用例库下所有用例
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the directory. Omit this parameter to return all test cases from the test case library
parameters.help_zh: 目录id，目录唯一标识，如果不填写，则默认该用例库下所有用例
parameters.name: directory_identifier

parameters.description_en: The conditions for filtering test cases, provided as a JSON string.
parameters.help_en: The conditions for filtering test cases, provided as a JSON string
parameters.name: conditions

parameters.description_en: The token for paginating results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response to retrieve the next page.
parameters.description_zh: 分页标识，第一页默认不用填写，下一页的参数从上一次调用结果获取
parameters.help_en: The token for paginating results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 分页标识，第一页默认不用填写，下一页的参数从上一次调用结果获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. The default value is 20.
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. The default value is 20
parameters.name: max_result
